titulo: Never Pass the Same Gas Station Three Times #Shorts
titulo_pt: Nunca passe pelo mesmo posto de gasolina três vezes
resumo_pt: O pai do narrador tinha uma regra para dirigir à noite: se passar pelo mesmo posto duas vezes, pare; nunca passe uma terceira. Ele ignora e passa três vezes. No posto, o frentista é o pai dele, desaparecido há dez anos, que diz que agora ele também ficou preso ali.
descricao:
My dad had one rule for driving at night. I broke it.

Would you have stopped the second time?

Follow @VeilFrequency for a new horror story every day. Fictional story. Images are AI-generated.

scenes.text: My dad had one rule for night drives. Never pass the same gas station three times.
scenes.visual: lonely two-lane highway at night, headlights cutting through light fog

scenes.text: If you pass it twice, you stop. No matter what.
scenes.visual: old roadside gas station glowing alone in the dark, one flickering light

scenes.text: Dad disappeared on a night drive ten years ago.
scenes.visual: old pickup truck parked on an empty dirt shoulder at night, driver door open

scenes.text: Last night I passed a little gas station on a back road.
scenes.visual: car headlights passing a small rural gas station, pumps lit, nobody around

scenes.text: Ten minutes later, I passed it again.
scenes.visual: the same small gas station seen through a car windshield, wipers frozen mid-swipe

scenes.text: I was late. I didn't stop.
scenes.visual: man's hands tight on a steering wheel, dashboard glowing in the dark

scenes.text: Third time, the attendant was standing by the road. Waving me in.
scenes.visual: silhouette of a man in a work jacket standing at the edge of a dark road, one hand raised

scenes.text: I pulled in. My hands were shaking.
scenes.visual: car pulling up to a gas pump under a buzzing light at night

scenes.text: He leaned down to my window.
scenes.visual: older man in a faded work jacket leaning toward a car window, face half in shadow

scenes.text: It was Dad. He hadn't aged a day.
scenes.visual: close-up of an older man's tired eyes in the dim glow of a gas station light

scenes.text: You should've stopped the second time, kiddo.
Now you're stuck here with me.
I've been driving in circles ever since. Would you have stopped?
scenes.visual: rear view mirror reflecting the same small gas station glowing far behind on a dark road
